detailed_descriptions.en: Start with almost nothing and build a thriving gold mining business from the ground up. Lease mining claims, operate heavy machinery, process tons of paydirt, and grow your operation into a mining empire. Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the most complete version of the game, bringing together every released expansion alongside new features, gameplay improvements, refreshed look, and quality of life upgrades. Explore a connected world without any loading screens. Travel between mining areas without interruptions in open world and enjoy a smoother, more immersive mining experience. Expand your mining operation with two brand new vehicles. The Fuel Truck keeps your machines supplied wherever you work, while the Large Dump Truck lets you transport even greater amounts of material, helping you scale your operation faster than ever. Looking for a different kind of challenge? A new customizable game mode lets you tailor the economy, progression, and gameplay rules to create your perfect mining experience. Managing your claim has never been easier. The new Claim Management Panel gives you quick access to gold processing, water management, and the newly introduced claim lighting system - all from one convenient interface. If you'd rather skip the Washplant setup, simply purchase an Assembly Service and get back to mining faster.
